snippet.title: Barely Afloat Steam Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/5440350/Barely_Afloat/

Take one small, leaky motorboat from a mountain pond all the way to the sea with up to 3 friends. Only one of you gets the wheel. The rest get a hammer, a bucket and a harpoon.

Patch the holes, bail the water, harpoon wrecks out of the way and dodge cannons, boulders, lightning and a shark that jumps across the river for no reason. Sink, and the whole crew goes back to the last safe dock.
